name: news-expose
label: News / scam-expose (face + kicker spine)
description: Measured on SPF/Mothership/Straits Times scam reels (research/genre-research-2026-10/news-doc-explainer.md A1). Voice from frame 0, persistent kicker header, 3-5 numbered steps of 4-6 s with cuts every ~1.7-2.5 s inside a step, one stat counter with source, numbered 'what to do' + helpline, logo. Continuous bed (time below -30 dBFS <= 15%), sting on the kicker, ticks on steps and screenshot slams.

_needs_feature.stat_counter_beat: beat role 'number' -> B-roll kind motion template stat-counter with a source line, plus the reveal stack
_needs_feature.numbered_steps: beat role 'step' auto-prefixes 1/2/3 on the hook/kicker card or a step-cards motion insert
_needs_feature.screenshot_slam: full-width screenshot on a blurred copy of itself with a red circle annotation; sfx 'paper'
_needs_feature.redact: auto-blur faces of unknown people, plates and phone/account digits in B-roll (QC already flags unknown faces)
_needs_feature.helpline_card: end card line from brand.compliance.helpline (SG ScamShield 1799)
